review_evidence: Reviewed the complete 18-file pinned snapshot and MDPLib project documentation.
MDPLib formalizes Markov decision processes, probability, risk measures such as Value at Risk, histories/policies, and verified algorithms/correctness properties.
The ten primary Lean files are substantive definitions and proofs; no lossless exclusion is warranted.
summary: Retain MDPLib as a substantive Lean formalization of MDPs, probability, risk measures, and verified algorithms.

review_evidence: Ran a Lean declaration-marker grep (theorem|lemma|def|structure|inductive|class|instance|abbrev|macro|elab|syntax|axiom|example, unanchored) across all 9 files: scores ranged from 0 (`MDPLib.lean`, `MDPLib/Risk/CVaR.lean`) to 105 (`MDPLib/Probability/Basic.lean`); two zero-hit files required full reads.

Read `MDPLib.lean` in full (410 bytes, 0 hits): a header comment plus 10 `import` lines listing every module of the library -- a FILTER-007 pure root import aggregator, no declarations of its own. Retained, no exclusion rule needed.

Read `MDPLib/Risk/CVaR.lean` in full (1323 bytes, 0 hits): two `import` lines, a `namespace Risk ... end Risk` block, and inside it a single large comment dated 2026-09-13 that is a genuine mathematical design note -- it identifies the absence of a discrete Markov inequality in Mathlib (naming `mul_meas_ge_le_lintegral` and its file location), specifies the two standard CVaR definitions this library will implement (`expect_cnd` for the conditional-expectation form, a `Finset.min'` optimisation form avoiding a real infimum), and points to the exact Mathlib/MDPLib lemmas needed (`Finset.sum_le_sum_of_subset_of_nonneg`, `Finset.card_nsmul_le_sum`, `Prob.complement_inv_nneg`, `exp_convexOn_le`). The `namespace` command takes the file outside FILTER-007's pure-import class per its own text, and the comment is substantive formalization-planning content (not junk, not a license/build artifact) whose documentation would be lost with no auxiliary channel if excluded -- does not meet the FILTER-004 hard-exclusion bar. Retained without a rule, consistent with FILTER-002's default-retain-when-uncertain.

The remaining 7 files (`MDPLib/MDP/Histories.lean`, `MDPLib/Probability/Basic.lean`, `MDPLib/Probability/Defs.lean`, `MDPLib/Probability/Prelude.lean`, `MDPLib/Probability/Quantile.lean`, `MDPLib/Risk/VaR.lean`, `Main.lean`) all scored 11-105 declaration markers and hold real MDP/probability/risk-measure formalization content consistent with the prior review's retain disposition; no file matched a known exclusion pattern from this session's precedents.

MDPLib/Probability/Quantile.lean: IsQuantile/IsQuantileLower definitions, quantile/quantileLower sets, maxQuantile, transformation lemmas (monotone/strictMono), cash invariance, negation duality
MDPLib/Risk/VaR.lean: RiskLevel, finVaRSet/finVaR (VaR definition), finVaR_spec correctness, IsVaR/IsVaRQuantile equivalence, quantile_nonempty, monotone/strictMono/cash-invariance properties

summary: Inspected all 7 changed/added Lean files in the MDPLib repository. All files contain substantial formal mathematical content: MDPLib/MDP/Histories.lean defines MDP structures, histories, and indexing with theorems; MDPLib/Probability/Basic.lean provides extensive probability/expectation theorems; MDPLib/Probability/Defs.lean contains core definitions (Findist, FinRV, probability, expectation) and foundational lemmas; MDPLib/Probability/Prelude.lean supplies supporting order/dot-product lemmas; MDPLib/Probability/Quantile.lean formalizes quantile definitions and properties; MDPLib/Risk/VaR.lean defines Value-at-Risk with correctness proofs and properties; MDPLib/Risk/CVaR.lean contains only design-note comments (no declarations), but the prior review RRV-f53773d26e78-r2 explicitly retained it as not meeting the FILTER-004 exclusion bar. No file qualifies for hard exclusion under FILTER-004: each contains definitions, theorems, or proofs relevant to formal mathematics search.
